## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see added.

## Problem or Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or specific workload requirement?
*e.g. I'm always frustrated when [...] or In our payment routing scenario, we need [...]*

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this working from an architectural, API, or CLI perspective.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Target Component
- [ ] Core Engine / State Fabric (`esa-core`, `esa-state`)
- [ ] Agent Reasoning & Policies (`esa-agents`, `esa-policy`)
- [ ] Execution Gateway / Connectors (`esa-gateway`, `esa-razorpay`)
- [ ] CLI / SDK (`esa-cli`, `sdk/typescript`)
- [ ] Frontend Dashboard / Simulator (`frontend`, `payment-simulator`)
- [ ] Other

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or references here.
